title: 1997 AHSME Problem 21
statement: For any positive integer \(n,\) let \[ f(n)= \begin{cases} \log_8n, & \log_8n\in\mathbb{Q},\\ 0, & \log_8n\notin\mathbb{Q}. \end{cases} \] What is \(\displaystyle\sum_{n=1}^{1997}f(n)?\)

solutions.text: For integer \(n,\) \(\log_8n\) is rational exactly when \(n\) is a power of \(2.\) The relevant values are \(n=2^k\) for \(0\le k\le10,\) and \(f(2^k)=\frac{k}{3}.\) Therefore the sum is \(\frac{0+1+\cdots+10}{3}=\frac{55}{3},\) so C is correct.
hints: Determine which integers can be rational powers of \(8=2^3\)
List the powers of \(2\) not exceeding \(1997\) and sum their base-\(8\) logarithms
